column1: # expected.tsv --- the oracle. The reusable asset is these fixtures and their verdicts, not
# buckets.sh: rewrite the tool in any language and it must still produce these three verdicts.
# `violated` is the negative control, and it is the one that matters. Its FINAL COUNTS are
# indistinguishable from a legitimate walk-in-progress -- only the arrival order shows that (g)
# took a second entry while three groups stood empty. A tool checking end-state alone passes it
# happily. If this fixture ever stops reporting VIOLATED, the invariant check has been lost.
